in_sanskrit.name: Najar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious, Conqueror
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Najar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Someone who overcomes obstacles and conquers their enemies or inner demons. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'najara', meaning 'to conquer'.

in_hindi.name: Najar
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious, Conqueror
in_hindi.long_meaning: Najar एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Someone who overcomes obstacles and conquers their enemies or inner demons. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'najara', meaning 'to conquer'.

in_tamil.name: Najar
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Victorious, Conqueror
in_tamil.long_meaning: Najar ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Someone who overcomes obstacles and conquers their enemies or inner demons. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'najara', meaning 'to conquer'.

in_telugu.name: Najar
in_telugu.long_meaning: Najar ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Someone who overcomes obstacles and conquers their enemies or inner demons. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'najara', meaning 'to conquer'.

in_marathi.name: Najar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Najar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Someone who overcomes obstacles and conquers their enemies or inner demons. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'najara', meaning 'to conquer'.

in_bengali.name: Najar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Victorious, Conqueror
in_bengali.long_meaning: Najar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Someone who overcomes obstacles and conquers their enemies or inner demons. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'najara', meaning 'to conquer'.
